description: High-contrast volumetric lighting for explosion and smoke environments — godrays, volumetric shadows, atmospheric depth.

orchestration_stages.label: Volume-Enabled Sky Base
orchestration_stages.description: Sky setup with volume scatter contribution enabled.
orchestration_hints: Enable volume contribution on sky. Low intensity — 0.2–0.5.

orchestration_stages.label: Strong Directional Key
orchestration_stages.description: High-intensity directional light for godray production.
orchestration_hints: Volume contribution ENABLED — this drives godrays.
artistic_constraints: Strong directionality required. Not diffuse ambient.

orchestration_stages.label: Volumetric Shadow Casting
orchestration_stages.description: Configure volumes to cast visible shadows onto ground and each other.
orchestration_hints: Enable volume shadow casting in Arnold render settings.
artistic_constraints: Pyro volume must cast visible shadow onto ground.
Shadow edge must be soft — not sharp.

orchestration_stages.label: Godray Configuration
orchestration_stages.description: Configure atmosphere scatter to produce visible godrays through smoke.
orchestration_hints: Phase function: anisotropic (Mie scatter) — forward scattering.
Godrays appear where light passes through gaps in smoke.
artistic_constraints: Godrays must be visible through smoke layer.

orchestration_stages.label: Secondary Bounce Fill
orchestration_stages.description: GI bounce fill from ground to recover shadow detail.
orchestration_hints: Enable GI bounce minimum 2. Ground bounce fills smoke underside.
artistic_constraints: Smoke underside must not be pure black. Faint warm bounce expected.

review_expectations.godrays: Godrays visible through smoke gaps. Directional and light-source-consistent.
review_expectations.volume_shadows: Pyro volume casts visible shadow on ground. Edge is soft.
review_expectations.color: Warm in key direction, cooler in shadow. Color temperature separation.
